canonical_listing_status.detail: No catalog row or recent write outcome exists

source_disposition: The bare path is intentional free/validation flow; changing it to a paid default would change the public API. The current /api/x402 and /.well-known/x402.json already name ?bundle=1.
first_broken_buyer_step: Direct GET of PayAI item.resource returns 400 instead of the 402 needed to begin payment. A client using inputSchema.queryParams.bundle=1 can still reach the paid challenge.
repair_path: PayAI docs say entries refresh forward-only on a /verify or /settle payload that echoes the current Bazaar declaration; /verify moves no funds but requires a signed payment payload. No re-index endpoint or public direct listing edit is documented.
blocked_by: No wallet signing, no spend, no new credentials, and no outreach in this lane. No source code change or facilitator write made.
